title: What Is YouTube TV? Plans, Pricing, & How to Sign Up
summary: YouTube TV overview: pricing, channel lineup basics, DVR features, add-ons, and the steps to sign up and start watching live.

Key Takeaways


What to know about YouTube TV at a glance.


1. 1


YouTube TV blends live television with flexible digital streaming.


2. 2


Its main plan offers over 100 channels and unlimited DVR.


3. 3


The service reaches nationwide audiences and exceeds ten million subscribers.


4. 4


Advertisers access personalized CTV placements through Google’s buying platforms.


5. 5


Younger viewers make YouTube TV especially valuable for marketers.
